review.description: S1–S6 define idempotent submission, private runtime evidence, automatic investigation/drafting/filing, explicit recovery, independent verified delivery and the shared report view. S4 now explicitly describes finalized unusable findings and fresh recovery; S5 retains verified closing commits and partial tracking evidence; S6 preserves loaded ranges during journal changes. Finalized uncertain publication no longer reserves an investigator; credential rate-limit deadlines span reporting operations/reports/processes. Dependency availability accepts checked native package evidence and a verified closing-fix ancestor, preserving Unknown for source-only or insufficient evidence. S2 excludes Cookie/Set-Cookie/id_token authentication material and accepted pre-settlement evidence must be investigated before stale results settle or unclaimed creation begins. Claimed effects still settle/reconcile once. S6 retains detail progress during ongoing journal activity. S1/S2 reject source-checkout evidence locations before private input is retained. S4 distinguishes interrupted publication before/after a creation claim and preserves newer-generation state against obsolete failures. S6 keeps pagination available through continuing slow background refreshes. S3/S4 preserve newer established issue identities/outcomes against delayed successful publishers, while retaining unrecorded-effect recovery. Creation failures proven before dispatch permit prerequisite recovery; potentially dispatched effects still require reconciliation.
review.implementation: Inspected the SQLite ledger, immutable admission inputs, retained lifecycle receipts, native CLI workflow, deterministic publication claim and GitHub routing/provenance checks. Foundation dependencies remain glossary then UI then behavior. The private provider wrapper restores the full retained lifecycle receipt across engine environment filtering; native authentication prerequisites fail with sign-in instructions before an investigation starts. Large accepted observations use a private immutable prompt file with deterministic admission inputs. Resume uncertainty retains its intent and requires acknowledged recovery; lifecycle receipt continuity preserves the actual prior resumed token. Finalized unusable findings release capacity and explicit retry creates a new generation. GitHub tracking verifies direct closing commits, enriches known fix versions and returns verified partial observations on later errors; the service merges them without discarding prior availability. The queue uses only current-generation retained publication intent plus attempted-create state, preserving the historical workflow handle and all reconciliation requirements without a new flag. Reporting HTTP requests use a Store-backed endpoint/credential hash deadline; no raw token is retained and unrelated provider traffic is unchanged. Refresh stops after recording the first retry-bearing failure. The native agent-workflow verifier reads its actual manifest, exact uploaded inventory/checksums and small dependency/conformance metadata, checks tag/source/version identity and associates only independently verified closing fixes through ancestry. Code Factory explicit component/fixed-issue attribution remains strict; no archive execution or cryptographic certification is claimed. The existing text sanitizer covers prefixed/raw/multiline/JSON cookie and identity-token forms and also protects private command diagnostics. A private admitted additions count binds immutable generation input; terminal settlement, known-issue association and atomic creation claims check current additions/admission identity. Fresh evidence queues another generation only after lifecycle finalization or before an unclaimed publication, preserving known issue identities and single-effect claims. Closing association accepts supported colon syntax without relaxing issue/repository boundaries. The evidence owner validates the data location before submission, additions and recovery notes as well as capture. Publication failure transitions transactionally bind admission identity, claim phase, eligible processing, evidence freshness and known issue identity. A failed publication child command persists bounded actionable recovery independently of cancellation, without replaying a claimed effect or overwriting a newer generation. finishIssue applies current identity, admission and newer-claim ownership before accepting a delayed result. The reporting HTTP owner reuses the existing definite-rejection type for encoding/configuration/authentication/cooldown failures before Client.Do, using fixed sanitized actionable text; dispatched request handling is unchanged. The interruption-test child has a local deadline, test timeout and bounded termination/reaping rather than depending on its enclosing suite. Complete authorization-header and proxy-key filtering fixes the privacy boundary in its existing evidence owner. Mutation list refresh settles its own render, starting queued journal work independently so successful mutations release controls. Publisher checkout now retrieves complete history at the same guard-selected ref. Header-array support uses the existing redactor rather than introducing parsing infrastructure. UI evidence attempts retain submitted text with their identity: unchanged uncertain retries reuse the attempt, and changed submitted text obtains a fresh identity.
review.tests: Read new assertions for concurrent submissions/publication, capture-time evidence, conflicts/redaction, missing prerequisites/information, real-controller fake-provider recovery/deadline, duplicate routing, uncertain creation, release mismatches and all three report browser fixtures. Installed-host/live filing acceptance stays explicitly open. The similar-title regression requires two creations for distinct observations unless an explicit duplicate identity is returned. HTTP boundary assertions distinguish definite rejected creation from uncertain server errors. The real-engine fake provider checks lifecycle identity and receives a new token on resume; fake login-status executables test prerequisite errors without real credentials. Read new TestUncertainResumeLifecycleNeedsAcknowledgedRecovery and TestFinalizedUnusableFindingsReleaseSlotAndAllowFreshInvestigation assertions. Extended the existing real-controller fixture with large accumulated evidence, immutable retry content, unreplayed entry intents and exact resumed-token ordering. Existing HTTP/service tracking assertions now cover closing commits, invalid/foreign evidence, partial release failures and fix-version enrichment; browser assertions cover pending-pagination journal races and exact issue destinations. Read extended uncertain-publication assertions proving another report starts while creation remains once, plus TestPriorGenerationFindingsDoNotReleaseUncertainPreparation and TestRefreshRateLimitStopsOtherOperationsAndReports. TestGitHubReportingCooldownSurvivesRestartAndSeparatesCredentials proves shared HTTP suppression, reopened Store/adapters, credential separation/expiry and safe pre-HTTP failure; rejected POST retains typed retry provenance. TestTrackingNativeWorkflowRelease uses real native metadata shapes and checks stable/prerelease delivery, independent closing fix ancestry, malformed identities/fingerprints/inventories/digests and source-only Unknown. The two new ordered-detail browser anchors assert actual rendered findings/processing/control state. Read extended privacy assertions for unknown observation/run/addition/prompt/draft and failing-command credentials while adjacent evidence remains. TestEvidenceAfterWorkerCompletionRequiresFreshGeneration distinguishes suspected, information and explained stale results; TestEvidencePublicationClaimBoundary injects evidence during validation/marker and generation races plus known/durable/uncertain claims, asserting no duplicate create. Existing native release fixtures accept colon closing references; the unexpected-upload test uses unique valid metadata and a complete checksum set, with an overlay mutation proving the inventory check is independently necessary. TestPrivateInputsAreRejectedBeforeCheckoutPersistence checks report/key/event absence and unchanged additions/recovery notes. TestPublicationCommandInterruptionRecovery uses a real child test process, durable reopened SQLite, canceled context, pre/post-claim recovery, queued progress and once-only reconciliation. TestObsoletePublicationFailuresPreserveActiveGeneration checks delayed validation/duplicate/marker/subprocess failures against exact current report/runtime. TestPublicationFailuresPreserveRecoveredIssueAndClaim covers recovered identities against late rejection/uncertain/reconciliation failures. The strengthened deadline subtest observes its exact fake provider alive, requires canceled/timeout/deadline evidence and process termination before teardown; a forced launch failure fails the oracle. UI-REPORTS-PAGE-PROGRESS establishes pagination availability during continuing journal updates. Controlled delayed duplicate successes preserve the exact newer completed report/runtime and a newer in-flight creation claim, including same-generation established identities; existing missing-identity recovery remains. TestHTTPPublicationFailuresBeforeDispatchAreDefinite asserts zero requests and safe diagnostics at five positive pre-dispatch boundaries. TestHTTPPublicationRecoveryDistinguishesTokenFailureFromLostResponse proves the durable service claim exists when token retrieval fails, no POST was dispatched, recovery after restored authentication sends exactly one POST, and a lost dispatched response stays uncertain through empty-marker lookup without a second POST. The interruption regression also forces a hung child and asserts locally bounded termination/reaping independently of parent cancellation. Current cycle reproduces unknown auth proof and structured proxy proof leakage, then verifies persisted observations/additions/findings, private bundle, investigator and publication exclusion. UI-REPORTS-MUTATION-PROGRESS keeps delayed background lists pending while refresh/evidence/acknowledged recovery enable and another evidence submission succeeds. Actual release.deliver runs from a workflow-depth local clone containing a historical nonempty fixed-issue registry; depth-one reproduction fails lookup and full-history repair passes exact package/ancestry validation without publishing. Extended privacy regression continues across retained report/bundle, added evidence, prepared investigator report and re-sanitized draft publication instead of stopping at the first leak. UI-REPORTS-EVIDENCE-RETRY simulates two lost acknowledgements after acceptance, proves unchanged retries append once with unchanged identity, then proves edited evidence appends exactly one distinct observation and clears the draft.
